newsitem.title: USA: Arizonan viewed as front-runner to head USDA's FSA.
newsitem.headline: Arizonan viewed as front-runner to head USDA's FSA.

text.p: Keith Kelly, Arizona's director of agriculture, was regarded Thursday as the likely appointee to run the U.S. Farm Service Agency, USDA and grain industry sources said.
Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman was scheduled to announcement the FSA appointment Friday at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT.
"I assume it's (Kelly). That's what everybody assumes," said one Agriculture Department official. Kelly also was mentioned by grain industry sources.

A former director of the Montana Department of Agriculture, Kelly has been Arizona agriculture director since the department was created in 1991. One of his major tasks recently was dealing with the karnal bunt outbreak in wheat.
